title: SOC Overlap Reduction on ClearPath After-Hours Remote Labor
content:
**Rule.** The SOC overlap reduction of the after-hours remote amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket reads the client's active Sentinel Managed Security subscription: a subscription whose tier includes threat hunting takes 10.0 percent off; an active subscription whose tier does not takes 5.0 percent off; no active subscription takes nothing off.

Whether threat hunting is included is a feature of the tier of the client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active.

| Client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription | Reduction |
|---|---|
| active, tier with threat hunting | 10.0 percent |
| active, tier without threat hunting | 5.0 percent |
| none active | nothing |
